title: Change log
subtitle: Release notes maintained inside this Multica platform.

v0_3_50.title: Choose the number of copy-based creative sets
v0_3_50.summary: Copy-library orders support 1-10 creative sets, defaulting to three, with three delivery sizes per set.
v0_3_50.change_1: Choose a set count and see the delivery image count before submitting. Ten sets deliver 30 images; the count is frozen with the order.
v0_3_50.change_2: Plan two additional candidates and let independent review select the requested number of directions. Ten-set orders compare 12 primary images.
v0_3_50.change_3: Keep existing task concurrency and reuse completed primary images when generating other sizes. Ranked reserves can replace failed initial deliveries without regenerating successful directions.
v0_3_50.change_4: Progress, delivery metrics, and agent contracts follow the frozen count. Material-based and historical orders retain the three-set default; gallery sets can be previewed and downloaded in batches.

v0_3_49.title: Copy-led creative production and gallery management
v0_3_49.summary: Create images from published copy, manage gallery packages with full previews, and configure GPT-6 Astra agents.
v0_3_49.change_1: Create creative orders from approved library copy. Headlines, benefits, supporting text, calls to action, and repayment plans are optional; selecting none starts visual-only exploration.
v0_3_49.change_2: Gallery packages have large previews and size switching. Removing a package preserves images and feedback, supports undo, and updates the order's add-to-gallery action.
v0_3_49.change_3: Codex agents can select GPT-6 Astra and the reasoning levels reported by their runtime, including Ultra when supported.
v0_3_49.change_4: Creative Factory initialization and bootstrap include the copy-library source contract across planning, production, and QC while retaining candidate selection and cross-size identity consistency.

v0_3_48.title: Direct adjustment delivery switching
v0_3_48.summary: After Prime composition, a direct adjustment now replaces the active delivery package by default.
v0_3_48.change_1: The before and after Prime-composed results can be switched in either direction without recreating work.
v0_3_48.change_2: Only completed Prime-composed delivery packages can be selected. Raw image-edit process images remain unavailable.
v0_3_48.change_3: Switching a completed historical result no longer appears as an in-progress update.
v0_3_48.change_4: Creative Factory initialization refreshes the direct-edit skill contract without overwriting user-managed resources.

v0_3_47.title: Creative candidates, native size layouts, and revision isolation
v0_3_47.summary: This release improves complete creative delivery and recovery: multiple primary concepts are compared before three delivery variants are chosen, each size receives a native layout, late image receipts are protected, and active revisions stay available during rework.
v0_3_47.change_1: Each material starts with four or five distinct primary-image candidates. Independent review selects three delivery variants atomically, while ranked reserves remain available for automatic promotion when an initial delivery is exhausted.
v0_3_47.change_2: Square, landscape, and portrait assets share CreativeIntent and DesignDNA but are generated with native layouts instead of depending on a square raster. The image model continues to render headlines, amounts, tables, and calls to action.
v0_3_47.change_3: Every size now records a durable image operation with attempts, provider request details, runtime, duration, and result receipt. Running or unknown calls are reconciled instead of being sent again, and successful sibling sizes are retained.
v0_3_47.change_4: Official Prime components are selected per size and checked against visible glyph polarity, contrast, and texture. A staging revision replaces the active revision only after all delivery gates pass.

v0_3_23.title: Creative Factory, model configuration, and platform updates
v0_3_23.summary: This release connects the Creative Factory workflow from material collection to image generation and delivery, adds workspace-level capability controls, introduces GPT-5.6 model choices with per-model thinking levels, and improves requirement filters, child issue ordering, and the platform update log.
v0_3_23.change_1: Creative Factory can be enabled independently per workspace and connects material collection, analysis, preparation, material and copy confirmation, image generation, and delivery. The API, navigation, and direct page access enforce the same capability control.
v0_3_23.change_2: Codex agents can select GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, or GPT-5.6 Luna, with the thinking levels available for each model. Every agent can configure its model and thinking level independently.
v0_3_23.change_3: Requirements support persisted label filters, with multiple labels using OR semantics. Workflow-created child issues now sort consistently by workflow stage, variant, revision, and issue identifier.
v0_3_23.change_4: The help menu and new-version announcement open the same internal update log, which brings version features and improvements together in Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean.
